WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
), with_average AS (
  SELECT dealedge, order_count, AVG(order_count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM side_counts
)
SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(order_count - avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM with_average
WHERE order_count > avg_count;
